limitations: Positive product scope is one public straight street demolition at seed1337 and one straight avenue at seed7, each inside a one-leaf bulldoze group. No native pointer or marquee coverage.

The integrity helper checks whether Buildings point to existing lots and whether populated lots point to a Building with matching lotId. It does not enforce building→lot.buildingId for every building, nor reject duplicate buildings on the same lot. Raw owner arrays are not retained for an independent reverse-link audit.

Retained SHA-256 rows allow independent before/undo, candidate/redo and candidate/failed comparisons over seven owners. Owner bytes are absent, so digest generation cannot be independently repeated. Repeat, normal undo, later state and rebuild-failure equalities are partly or wholly retained booleans rather than paired payloads/digests.

Later construction checks full serialized building record and inverse lot link, but post-records are absent. requestSpawn/demolish/setLevel are real public owner operations, followed by one Simulation step; this is not long autonomous/native UI growth.

One-shot Zoning and rebuild refusal overrides return false before the real owner operation. Initial graph mutation and inverse graph/terrain changes do exercise compensation ordering, but arbitrary partial rebuild corruption, thrown late failures and persistent second compensation refusal remain untested.

Failure-probe is a separate failure-only run with identical retained rebuildFailures; its pass does not stand for full two-seed image/repeat coverage. Some specialized checks omit engine snapshot error arrays/readiness from their final pass, though they capture browser errors; main run integrity includes readiness and engine errors.
Road construction initial rebuild failure, curved demolition, multi-leaf grouping, saved pending history, long unpaused economy behavior, and persistent recovery are not accepted by this round.

The cross-seed terrain loop counts differences above1e-6 only. API double deserialize is Democity-specific. Save atomicity compares a normalized canonical baseline and has an expected injected Transit error.

Eight before/after original PNGs are same product source, not pre-R9u/post-R9u source; no undo/redo screenshots or PNG-specific frame sidecars were supplied. All original images, four differences and contact sheet were individually viewed at original resolution.
Image changes include Traffic, foliage, water and UI; image MAE is not a road-only quality measure. No new FPS/heap/night/weather/blind/reference or whole-game gate result. Keep6.0 FAIL.
